item.title: [7.1] Global Market: Euro zone bond yields hover near 15-year highs as Middle East war fuels inflation fears
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Euro zone bond yields stayed near 15-year highs as Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation raised expectations for ECB rate hikes. Germany’s 10-year Bund yield held around 3.20%, while widening Italy-Germany spreads highlighted growing geopolitical, inflation and fiscal risks across the region.

WHY IT MATTERS

Sustained multi-year highs in Euro zone bond yields driven by geopolitical inflation risks represent a critical cross-asset signal for global macro portfolios.

item.title: [6.8] Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this...

WHY IT MATTERS

The Mobius architecture introduces a structural separation of knowledge and reasoning that demonstrates significant data efficiency and a reported 4x inference speedup, though real-world validation is still needed.
